user_input: All people are born free and equal in dignity and rights.
reference: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

user_input: Rights in this declaration apply to everyone without discrimination.
reference: Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status.

user_input: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.
reference: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person.

user_input: Can someone be held as a slave under this declaration?
reference: No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms.

user_input: What does the declaration say about torture?
reference: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.

user_input: Are men and women treated the same under the law?
reference: All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law.

user_input: Do people have the right to share their opinions publicly?
reference: Everyone has the right to freedom of opinion and expression; this right includes freedom to hold opinions without interference and to seek, receive and impart information and ideas through any media and regardless of frontiers.
